# Connect your apps with

## API

Integrate your business applications like CRM, Helpdesk, Internal communication platforms, using
SurveySparrow API and nourish your enterprise environment.

![Improve experience management with API.](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/features-new/extend-capabilities-with-api.png)

## Webhooks

Communicate with any third-party application using SurveySparrow’s webhooks. This can be to pass survey
data to another application, for instance.

![Transfer data to any configured URL from any survey using Webhooks.](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/features-new/extend-capabilities-with-webhooks.png)

## Integrations

If not API or Webhooks, with just a button, you can directly integrate SurveySparrow with umpteen
applications like Zapier, Aweber, Facebook Pixel, Zendesk, Hubspot, Slack, Intercom, Salesforce,
MailChimp, WordPress, Rybbon.

![Connect with your everyday applications using native integrations.](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/assets/features-new/extend-capabilities-with-native-integrations.png)
